[SWS_UCM_00199] Reporting of
Software Cluster
reaching end of life-cycle
⌈
Any
Software Cluster
reaching the end of its life-cycle shall not be reported by
UCM
any more.
⌋
(RS_UCM_00011)
7.1.2 Technical Overview
One of the declared goals of
AUTOSAR Adaptive Platform
is the ability to flexibly
update the software and its configuration through over-the-air updates. During the life-
cycle of an
AUTOSAR Adaptive Platform
,
UCM
is responsible to perform software
modifications on the machine and to retain consistency of the whole system.
